description: Age open invoices into 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days past DUE date at a date, per client and currency, with the invoices themselves. Free. statements_report rolls up the whole book instead.

as_of.description: Age the invoices as at this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today

client.description: One client id or name. Omit to age every client in the books

currency.description: Only this currency. Omit for every currency, each aged separately

limit.description: Maximum invoice rows returned, default and ceiling 2000

name: statement_aging
title: Age the open invoices
